Give it your best!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 25 ([[Headache Headquarters]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Toilet Boss''' was a final boss of [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Grave Digger]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every modern [[Grave Digger]] variant. It has a high amount of health but a quite slow speed, being one of the slowest enemies in the entire game. As it is a [[Boss]] enemy, it is immune fully or partially to most forms of stalling in the game. It has two abilities. Its ''Ant McPartlin'' ability fires multiple beam rays at towers, stunning them for 8-12 seconds and dealing 10 damage to units per tick. The ''Declan Donnelly'' ability triggered a laugh, summoning multiple enemies. These can be the [[Metal Toilet]], [[Toilet]], [[Ninja Toilet]] and [[Armored Toilet]]. ==Appearance== The '''Toilet Boss''' is a giant white toilet. The toilet has six fans attached to it, three on each side. It has four laser guns that are connected to an orange core in the middle of it. A head comes out of the toilet. It has black hair, pale skin, yellow glowing eyes, {{RLinkC|86487700|Man Face}} and an earpiece. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]] or [[Minigunner]] are heavily recommended. **Do note that the [[Accelerator]] may struggle against the enemies summoned by the '''Toilet Boss''', as it will be locked onto the '''Toilet Boss'''. It is recommended to have other towers alongside it. *Area of effect towers like the [[Shotgunner]], [[Mortar]] and [[Pyromancer]] can be very useful against the enemies summoned by the '''Toilet Boss'''. **The [[Shotgunner]] is also capable of killing the '''Toilet Boss''' by itself. *The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be quite useful at boosting the firerate and range of towers respectively. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse stuns caused by the '''Toilet Boss'''. *Freezing towers like the [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]] cannot freeze the '''Toilet Boss''', but they can slow it down. **Stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] also cannot stun it, but can slow it down. **The [[Jester]]'s confusion bomb is quite useful as it is unaffected by all of its immunities. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] cannot slow it down. *You can place down multiple cheap towers on the side to distract the '''Toilet Boss''', as a way to prevent it from stunning your DPS towers. ==Trivia== *The '''Toilet Boss''' is based on the [[w:c:skibidi-toilet:G-Toilet_4.0|G-Toilet 4.0]] from ''Skibidi Toilet''. *The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] called the '''Toilet Boss''' as the [[Grave Digger]] in dialogue.
